Santa.style: Papá Noel on holiday in Montevideo in the summer, playing chess against his friend El Mago: a big, jolly old man with a deep, slightly gravelly, warm voice. Quick comic timing, never slow. First line: proud and boastful, chest out (he is from the North Pole, so of course he plays the vikings). Second line: celebrating far too early, a triumphant belly laugh. Third line: he misunderstood 'jaque mate' and thinks his friend is offering him a mate (the Uruguayan drink): delighted and innocent, happily asking him to pour one.

Mago.style: El Mago, a kind, older wizard from Montevideo with a warm voice and a playful smile, playing chess against his friend Papá Noel. First line: an epic, dramatic movie-trailer announcement, but short. Second line: calm and confident, a little smug. Third line: completely deadpan, dry, almost bored, the winning move. Fourth line: warm and inviting, straight to the viewer, a playful challenge.
